import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    T = int(data[n+1])
    
    ans = 0
    a.sort()
    
    for i in range(n):
        p = i + 1
        while p < n and abs(a[i] - a[p]) <= T:
            p += 1
        ans = max(ans, p - i)
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
